description: Gated Residual (Qwen4ExpTextGatedResidual) layer-0 attn_hyper_connection reference fixture. Weight VALUES are a real, contiguous slice of the real Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoint's model.language_model.layers.0.attn_hyper_connection.* tensors (shard model-00001-of-00131.safetensors), truncated from hidden_size=2560/hc_count=4/hc_lowrank=320 down to hidden_size=8 (hc_count and hc_lowrank sliced too, see config_small). The forward pass itself is the real transformers 5.16.1 Qwen4ExpTextGatedResidual.forward(), run on CPU with use_combine=True.
dtype: float32 little-endian, raw flat binary, row-major (C order)
notes: Column slice preserves the real per-stream grouping: for each of the hc_count=4 groups of width hidden_size_full=2560 in the wide hc_count*hidden_size axis, the FIRST hidden_size_small=8 channels are kept (indices g*2560 .. g*2560+7 for g in 0..3), so hc_norm's group_size=hidden_size RMS grouping and the stream-reshape (unflatten(-1,(hc_count,hidden_size))) both remain structurally faithful at the small scale.

hc_count is NOT sliced (kept at the real value 4) since it is the architecturally load-bearing stream count this whole mechanism exists to test; only hidden_size (2560->8) and hc_lowrank (320->6) are sliced, both being ordinary Linear-projection widths with no per-head/group structure of their own to preserve.

The module's OWN full forward (RMSNorm group-norm, low-rank down/up sigmoid gate, mean over streams, and the separate block_inject sigmoid*2 injection-weight head) all ran unmodified real code -- nothing about this fixture is a hand re-derivation of the formula.
